name: Tocoya
description: Tocoya was a planet located within the Tocoya system of the Inner Rim and the homeworld of the Tocoyan race. Neb Dulo, a disciple of the religion Davrilat, was from the planet.
lead_paragraphs: Tocoya was a planet located within the Tocoya system of the Inner Rim and the homeworld of the Tocoyan race. Neb Dulo, a disciple of the religion Davrilat, was from the planet.
